title: Tolerance
description: The body must also know not to attack itself: regulatory cells that call off the response. Reality has them too, and a breach is read as self. Law Wraiths leave you be.

puzzle.goal: Effector cells of number E are held down by regulatory cells R, each damping by g. Write the net drive D they have left.
puzzle.name: Net drive
puzzle.ask: Find D for E = @{E}, g = 3 and R = @{R}.
puzzle.method: Regulatory cells subtract from the response; enough of them hold it at zero, so the body tolerates itself.
